report_text:
POSTMORTEM EXAMINATION REPORT

Subject: Aditya Gupta | Age: 29
Body Temperature at Scene: 24.0°C | Ambient Temperature: 22.1°C
Postmortem Interval (estimated): 5.7 hours

INJURIES IDENTIFIED:
  1. Cranial: Blunt force trauma with {severity} fracture [SEVERE]
  2. Abdominal: Blunt force trauma with splenic laceration [MODERATE]
  3. Lower Limb: Multiple contusions consistent with assault [MILD]
  4. Upper Limb: Defensive bruising on forearms [MODERATE]

TOXICOLOGY (Preliminary): Carbon Monoxide, Chloroform, Ketamine

RIGOR MORTIS: Partial rigor — early stage.
LIVOR MORTIS: Fixed posterior — no repositioning detected.

FORENSIC NOTES:
The pattern of injuries and postmortem indicators are consistent with a premeditated assault by an attacker known to the victim. Toxicological findings suggest victim was sedated prior to the fatal assault.
